They installed 29 artificial nesting hollows to combat the lack of natural breeding sites. This first successful breeding event is a pivotal achievement in palm cockatoo conservation. Ongoing monitoring will assess how well these new hollows can facilitate nesting and chick growth for this endangered species.

Surprisingly, studies reveal that these colonies have reached an impasse, maintaining fixed borders even amid continuous aggression, indicating a lengthy conflict without an end in sight.

title: Jalaj Saxena equals Bishan Bedi as Kerala notch up innings win against Odisha

title: Google’s order for thousands of Waymo taxis has left many in the US government worried

These vehicles will support the company’s expansion of its driverless taxi service across various US cities. US lawmakers and safety experts express concerns regarding potential security risks related to imported vehicles from China. A bipartisan proposal aims to restrict vehicles manufactured in China, emphasizing compliance with government rules about connected vehicle technology.

title: Israel planned intense strikes against Iran on Oct 10, but Trump said no: Report
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was preparing an aggressive attack on Iranian targets amid growing tensions. However, US President Donald Trump opposed these military actions prior to the midterm elections. Reports indicate that Israeli military forces were ready to launch strikes on October 10, focusing on critical Iranian infrastructure. Diplomatic efforts regarding Iran's nuclear program and US sanctions remain contentious and unresolved.

title: Dallas' Forest Theater set to relight tower after 50 years in $45m revamp
description: On November 1, Dallas's iconic Forest Theater is poised to make its grand return following significant restoration efforts. With a staggering $45 million injection aimed at modernizing its cultural offerings, the reopening promises live performances and food vendors to engage the community. The relighting of the Tower and marquee heralds a rejuvenated era, fostering support for local artists and revitalizing the South Dallas cultural scene.

title: Where India stands in Asian Para Games medal tally after 27-medal haul on Day 3
description: In an impressive showing at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games, India has claimed 27 medals, comprising five gold, pushing their total count to 62 after three days. Standing in fifth place, Indian athletes showcased their prowess, with athletics leading the charge and bringing home 18 medals along with new Games records. Other disciplines, including archery, swimming, and badminton, also contributed to the nation's medal haul.

title: Tests reveal Roman coffin at Westminster Abbey may hold medieval abbot
eMudhra security breach: What it means for smartphone, internet users
description: Researchers found that eight digital certificates issued by eMudhra had weak secret keys that could be easily exploited. Browser companies like Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Mozilla responded by blocking these certificates rapidly. eMudhra explained that a flaw during the creation process led to the publication of the weak keys. Importantly, no evidence suggests these weak keys were used in actual attacks so far.

title: GRAP-1 invoked in Delhi-NCR: What is banned, what is allowed from November 1
description: Delhi-NCR has invoked Stage 1 of the Graded Response Action Plan due to poor air quality levels. Restrictions will affect coal-fired tandoors and diesel generator use at eateries to mitigate pollution. Vehicle restrictions will come into effect from November 1, especially targeting non-compliant vehicles. Staggered office timings and increased parking charges aim to reduce congestion and emissions. Authorities plan to closely monitor air quality and implement additional measures as needed.

title: Russia to send first diesel shipment to US on Thursday amid global supply crunch
description: On Thursday, Russia is preparing to deliver its inaugural 40,000-tonne diesel shipment to the United States as part of a deal aimed at alleviating worldwide diesel shortages. However, Ukraine has raised alarms that this could inadvertently support Russian military operations in the ongoing conflict. With more diesel shipments anticipated, the energy markets in Europe may experience notable fluctuations.

title: London council moves to scrap demolition of 2 estates after 12-year fight
description: In a pivotal decision, Lambeth Council has announced plans to halt the demolition of the Central Hill and Cressingham Gardens housing estates. The focus will shift toward improving existing homes and fostering community ties, sparing residents from the threat of eviction. This significant turnaround, subject to Cabinet approval on October 21, marks a commitment to preserve community integrity and architectural character.

title: Russian roulette: Trump bites the bullet with Putin in bid to survive US midterms
description: For Trump, the political calculation appears straightforward. If Russian supplies arrive quickly and in sufficient quantities, they could help ease fuel prices and give his party a political boost. If deliveries fall short or prices remain high, the administration could end up granting Moscow significant economic relief without delivering much for American consumers.

title: Big relief for Das, Ranka: CJP leaders released after 7 days; Dipke posts SRK clip
description: A special executive magistrate court in Delhi reserved its order regarding the custody of CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The police sought an extension of three days for their custody following a protest at Jantar Mantar. During the proceedings, Das and Ranka challenged the custody extension in the Delhi high court. The high court advised them to await the SEM's decision before seeking further legal remedies.

title: Asian Para Games: Simran, Praveen, Sachin shine as India's medal tally swells to 62
description: India's athletics team celebrated a remarkable achievement by winning five gold medals at the Asian Para Games. Sprinter Simran and high-jumper Praveen Kumar set new Games records in their categories. The morning session also saw four silver medals added to the total. Success flowed from other disciplines too, such as badminton, para-archery, and para-swimming. With more competitions ahead, Indian athletes aim for even greater achievements.

No injuries were reported, and the ride reopened after maintenance inspections and safety checks. The incident follows the death of Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem at Six Flags Over Georgia. Travis Kelce’s reported role as a Six Flags ambassador and investor has drawn added attention, although no link connects him to either incident.

title: London taxi driver's £40 Amritsar painting sold for £75,000 in 2016

Thought to be the work of artist Baba Bishan Singh, this event highlights the pivotal role of expert appraisals in unveiling the true worth of hidden treasures in art.

title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper may launch November 1; check timings, fares
description: The Vande Bharat sleeper train has a 16-coach configuration, comprising 11 AC three-tier coaches, four AC two-tier coaches and one AC First Class coach. Designed for operations at speeds of up to 160 kmph, the train has a maximum testing speed of 180 kmph, placing it in the semi-high-speed category. However, much of the Indian Railways network currently lacks the infrastructure needed to support train operations at these speeds

title: Randi Mahomes launches Chiefs collection with Game Day Couture

Patrick Mahomes’ mother shared an Instagram video on Monday, modelling T-shirts, crew necks and dressier tops featuring the team’s logo. She encouraged fans to explore the collection and choose their favourite looks. Randi also continues to support the Chiefs in person, recently travelling to Las Vegas with her son Jackson for their game against the Raiders.

description: A rare first edition of Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone has fetched a staggering $400,000 at auction. This prized copy is distinguished by its printing errors and unique characteristics, appealing to avid collectors. With only 500 hardcover copies originally issued, many destined for libraries, the sale underscores the enduring allure of the Harry Potter saga, especially in anticipation of its upcoming screen adaptation scheduled for December 2026.

title: Monsoon's gone, El Nino isn't: Why India's weather worries are far from over
description: El Niño is increasingly influencing global weather patterns including agriculture and temperatures in India. Current forecasts predict a warmer winter as El Niño intensifies, which could affect agriculture adversely. Recent monsoon rainfall deficits raise concerns regarding water resources and crop yields moving forward. Different regions may experience varying extremes from drought to flooding in the coming months due to this phenomenon.

Although the court initially granted them ownership of the access road, it later corrected this decision. Ultimately, they received a permanent easement, illustrating the difference between property rights and ownership. The couple can access their property while the neighbor retains the land under the road.

This substantial donation will provide essential equipment, including a mobile MRI unit and a state-of-the-art 3D mammography machine. Their philanthropic efforts have already benefited over 100 local organizations, emphasizing their dedication to listening to community needs and promoting health and wellness initiatives.

title: Hindus, Muslims celebrate festivals of both faiths in this Madurai village

This event highlighted the communal harmony that exists between the village's Hindu and Muslim communities. Villagers participated in diverse religious practices and shared contributions during various festivals throughout the year. A community feast followed the mosque's inauguration, emphasizing mutual respect and unity.

title: How much debt is too much for Tamil Nadu?
description: The debt dynamics in Tamil Nadu present a perplexing scenario of borrowing intertwined with fiscal strategies. By 2026-2027, the burden of interest payments is expected to significantly eat into state revenue. The imminent maturity of most public debt within seven years heightens refinancing risks. To bolster fiscal health, a shift towards productive borrowing and enhanced public expenditure management is essential for the state's economic longevity.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
description: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.
